Premise: Two warbands collide in ruined streets and fight it out.
Roles: None (underdog matters only for the Chest twist)
Deployment: Roll-off winner picks an entry point (corners; the diagonally opposite one is the opponent's). Each player randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 12" horizontally of their entry point. Other groups start in reserve.
Victory Conditions: Hold the Centre: at the end of any round, a warband with fighters within 6" horizontally of the centre and no enemy fighters there scores d3 VP | Death Marks: each enemy fighter taken down scores the opposing warband 1 VP | A warband with 8+ VP at the end of a round ends the battle; most VP wins | If both have 8+ and are tied, the battle continues
Flee Rules: Otherwise the battle ends when a warband flees and the opposing warband wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +10 First Blood (first fighter to take down an enemy fighter with an attack)

Premise: Two warbands race to claim treasure hidden in a ruined district.
Deployment: Roll-off winner picks an entry point (diagonal is the opponent's). Each player randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 12" horizontally of their entry point. Other groups start in reserve.
Treasure Setup: 3 treasure tokens, placed alternately starting with the underdog. The first within 3" of the centre; each other within 8" horizontally of the centre and more than 3" from all other tokens
Victory Conditions: Claim Treasure: a warband with 3 fighters escaped with treasure ends the battle immediately and wins
Flee Rules: Otherwise the battle ends when a warband flees and the opposing warband wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +10 per fighter that escapes with treasure

Premise: Two warbands fight to drive each other out of an important district.
Deployment: Roll-off winner picks an entry point (diagonal is the opponent's). Each player randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 9" horizontally of their entry point. Other groups start in reserve.
Victory Conditions: Domination: battlefield is divided into 4 quarters. From round 3, at the end of a round a player with more friendly fighters wholly in a quarter than enemy fighters controls it and scores 1 mark | Fighters wholly within 6" of the centre belong to no quarter | A warband with 10+ marks and the score not tied ends the battle immediately; most marks wins
Flee Rules: Otherwise the battle ends when a warband flees and the opposing warband wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +1 Hold Ground: each time a player scores domination marks, each friendly fighter wholly within that quarter earns 1 XP

Premise: Two warbands fight over a ruined chapel at the centre of the battlefield.
Deployment: Roll-off winner picks an entry point (diagonal is the opponent's). Each player randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 9" horizontally of their entry point. Other groups start in reserve. The chapel is a 12" x 16" area at the centre.
Treasure Setup: The underdog places 3 treasure tokens inside the chapel, each within 1" of a different corner
Victory Conditions: Death Marks: each enemy fighter taken down scores the opposing warband 1 mark | A warband with 8+ marks at the end of a round ends the battle; most marks wins | If both have 8+ and are tied, the battle continues
Flee Rules: Otherwise the battle ends when a warband flees and the opposing warband wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +10 First to Step Inside (first fighter to finish a Move wholly within the chapel) | +2d6 Prying Off the Sarcophagus Lid (only if there is a sarcophagus; the fighter that pries it off)

Premise: An ambush: one warband tries to kill a marked enemy fighter (the Hit) before it escapes down the street.
Roles: Ambusher = the underdog; Defender = the other warband
Battle Groups (per warband): Defender: the Hit plus d6 accompanying fighters (no other Leaders/Champions), remaining fighters in 2 battle groups. Ambusher: 2
Deployment: The roll-off winner picks 1 Leader or Champion in the Defender's warband to be the Hit; the Defender picks which end of the street is the escape edge. Defender sets up the Hit and accompanying fighters anywhere on the street more than 18" from the escape edge; the rest start in reserve. Ambusher randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up anywhere more than 12" from all enemy fighters; the rest start in reserve.
Reinforcements Start (round): Ambusher 2; Defender 3. Arriving fighters get a d6 for edge instead of the reinforcement roll: 1 = edge opposite the escape edge, 2-3 = left edge, 4-5 = right edge, 6 = escape edge; set up wholly within 6" of that edge and more than 6" from enemy fighters
Victory Conditions: Escape the Ambushers: if the Hit finishes a move within 1" of the escape edge and is not engaged in melee, the battle ends immediately and the Defender wins | If the Hit is taken out of action, the battle ends immediately and the Ambusher wins
Flee Rules: No Easy Way Out: the Defender takes no flee tests and cannot voluntarily flee. If the Ambusher flees, the Defender wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +20 To the Hit or the Hitter: the Hit earns 20 XP if it escapes; if an enemy fighter takes the Hit down, that fighter earns 20 XP

Premise: The Defender holds a ruined holding full of treasure until help arrives while the Attacker tries to take it.
Roles: Attacker = roll-off winner; Defender = roll-off loser (re-roll ties)
Deployment: Defender randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 3" horizontally of the holding (an 8" x 8" area at the centre); other groups start in reserve. Attacker picks an entry point (diagonal is the Defender's), randomly picks 1 battle group and sets it up wholly within 6" horizontally of it; other groups start in reserve.
Treasure Setup: The Defender places 5 treasure tokens within 3" of the centre of the holding. Defender fighters cannot pick up treasure until round 3
Victory Conditions: Claim Treasure: a warband with 3 fighters escaped with treasure ends the battle immediately and wins
Flee Rules: Otherwise the battle ends when a warband flees and the opposing warband wins
Campaign Bonus XP (summary): +10 per fighter that escapes with treasure
